job.title: [Post] WE'RE HIRING | TECH LEAD – SALESFORCE COMMERCE CLOUD (SFCC) Location ... looking for an ex…

tailoring.headline: Tech Lead & SAP Commerce Cloud Developer | Java, Spring & OCC REST APIs
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years of enterprise e-commerce platform experience at Rockwell Automation and Shell, specializing in Java, Spring Boot, RESTful APIs, and SAP Commerce Cloud. Proven expertise in building, extending, and integrating large-scale e-commerce architectures, PIM/ERP/MDM integrations, database performance tuning, and API development. Certified SAP Commerce Cloud Developer adept at leading technical solutions and collaborating with international business and engineering teams.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: TECH LEAD – SALESFORCE COMMERCE CLOUD (SFCC)
cover_en.hook: I am writing to express my strong interest in the Tech Lead position. With over 5 years of specialized experience designing, developing, and leading robust enterprise e-commerce solutions at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep technical expertise in building scalable commerce platforms, integrating complex backends, and steering technical delivery.

bullets.label: Commerce Architecture & Leadership
bullets.text: Designed and implemented comprehensive backend and frontend functionality on SAP Commerce Cloud using Java and Spring, establishing robust platform architectures, executing code reviews, and providing technical guidance to developers.

bullets.label: API Design & Integration
bullets.text: Developed and exposed OCC REST Web Services and headless APIs, customizing Interceptors, Populators, and Converters for seamless data exchange across enterprise systems.

bullets.label: Enterprise Data Flows
bullets.text: Engineered complex PIM-to-commerce data pipelines using Profisee, Hotfolders, and DataHub, resolving integration bottlenecks between SAP ERP and MDM platforms.

bullets.label: Technical Delivery & Optimization
bullets.text: Executed CI/CD deployment cycles on cloud portals, led database query refactoring to significantly reduce response latency, and drove high-performance agile delivery.

cover_en.logistics: I am based in Karlsruhe, hold a valid German residence and work permit, and am serving my notice period with a last working day on 15 December 2026, making me available to start from 16 December 2026. I look forward to discussing how my enterprise commerce expertise aligns with your technical leadership needs.

tailoring.why_company: I am eager to bring my 5+ years of enterprise e-commerce and technical delivery experience to your team. Having built, scaled, and integrated high-performance commerce platforms for global leaders like Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am excited to apply my expertise in API design, platform architecture, and cross-functional leadership to drive impactful commerce solutions for your organization.
tailoring.motivation_short: Seeking to leverage 5+ years of enterprise e-commerce engineering and technical leadership experience to drive scalable commerce solutions.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hello Janaki, I saw your post for the Tech Lead role. With 5+ years of enterprise e-commerce engineering experience building large-scale platforms, APIs, and data integrations at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am very interested. Let's connect! Best, Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_subject: Application for Tech Lead – Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am applying for the Tech Lead position. With over 5 years of professional experience engineering enterprise e-commerce platforms, RESTful APIs, and complex backend integrations at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep technical depth and leadership capabilities to your team.

My CV and cover letter are attached to this email. I hold a valid German work permit, am serving my notice period until 15 December 2026, and can start on 16 December 2026.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
